dataformat.name: protobuf
dataformat.title: Protobuf
dataformat.description: Serialize and deserialize Java objects using Google's Protocol buffers
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: A protobuf Message, such as a generated class or a DynamicMessage, or a Map of the fields of the message, which needs instanceClass or schema. JSON text is not converted

marshalOut.description: The protobuf binary data, or JSON with contentTypeFormat json, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: Protobuf binary data, or JSON with contentTypeFormat json: unmarshal fails without instanceClass or schema

unmarshalOut.description: The generated class of instanceClass, such as AddressBookProtos$Person, or a com.google.protobuf.DynamicMessage with schema; convertBodyTo Map gives its fields

instanceClass.description: Name of class to use when unmarshalling.

schema.description: The protobuf schema, the text of a .proto file, used instead of instanceClass with the GoogleProtobuf library: messages are read into and written from a com.google.protobuf.DynamicMessage, so no class generated by protoc is needed. It may refer to a resource, such as classpath:order.proto, file:order.proto or an http URL. This needs camel-protobuf-schema on the classpath.

messageName.description: The message type of the schema to use, such as Order, shop.Order or the nested Order.Line. By default the first message type of the schema.

contentTypeFormat.description: Defines a content type format in which protobuf message will be serialized/deserialized from(to) the Java been. The format can either be native or json for either native protobuf or json fields representation.

contentTypeHeader.description: Whether the data format should set the Content-Type header with the type from the data format. For example application/xml for data formats marshalling to XML, or application/json for data formats marshalling to JSON
